findings.quoted_text: No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
No compensation with respect to a Fund shall be due and owing hereunder until the Distributor actually receives payments from such Fund, to the extent applicable.
findings.explanation: Your compensation is conditional on the Distributor receiving payment from the Fund, meaning you bear the risk of third-party non-payment.
findings.suggested_change: The Distributor shall pay all compensation due to S2K within thirty (30) days of the invoice date, regardless of whether the Distributor has received payment from the Fund.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to raise one point. - Regarding the relevant clause, compensation is currently conditional on receiving payment from a third party, which shifts the risk of third-party non-payment to the provider. We propose that payment be due within thirty days of the invoice date, regardless of whether the third-party payment has been received. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
